# Reference portfolio attribution

The illustrated scene implementation was adapted from https://github.com/Saksham-dev-del/Portfolio (MIT license; the original upstream notices are preserved in reference-portfolio-LICENSE.txt). The repository also credits Tomasz Szmajda as the original illustrated portfolio author.

The reference README distinguishes its original illustration assets from its MIT software license. Those original decorative assets retain their original authorship; this file does not relicense them. A public release should honor the asset author's reuse terms. Personal avatars, project posters and achievement/education artwork have been replaced with portfolio-specific code-generated artwork.

Tatheer's personal information is supplied by the existing data/ and lib/constants.ts files. No reference analytics or contact-service credentials are included.
